      ,[SystemID]
      ,H.[LabelColour]
      ,[LabelNumber]
      ,H.[CountryCode]
      ,[Franchise]
      ,[PriceSoldAtExGST]
      ,[DateAllocatedUTC]
      ,[ExternalReference]
      ,[CustomerID]
      ,H.[FKID]
      ,H.[FKSource]
      ,H.[FMSInvoiceID]
      ,H.[FMSProductID]
      ,[AllocatedByCustomer]
      ,[CustomerUniqueID]
      ,[PickupTown]
      ,[PickupPostcode]
      ,[DeliveryTown]
      ,[DeliveryPostcode]
      ,[Weight]
      ,[DateAllocatedRelativeToRF]
      ,[DeletedLabel]
      ,[DeliveryAddr1]
      ,[DeliveryAddr2]
      ,[PickupAddr1]
      ,[PickupAddr2]
      ,H.[GroupTransId]
      ,[DeliveryPhoneNo]
      ,[LengthInCm]
      ,[WidthInCm]
      ,[HeightInCm]
      ,[CubicWeight]
FROM  [Staging].[API_RF_AdHocLabel_AllocationHistory_Stg_Weekly] H
INNER JOIN  [FastwayDW].[dv].[SAT_Label_Allocation_DL] DL ON H.HistoryID = DL.[RecordSourceId] AND DL.IsCurrent = 1
WHERE (

	(DL.Price != H.[PriceSoldAtExGST] )  OR 
	( ISNULL(DL.FMSInvoiceID,0) != ISNULL(H.FMSInvoiceID,0) )  
)

--Get Previous Sunday or Today if day is SUN  - 19050101 was a SUN
DECLARE @maxDate  date = DATEADD(wk, DATEDIFF(wk, '19050101',  GETDATE()), '19050101')

       [HistoryID]

      ,[LabelColour]

  WHERE [HistoryID] > @LastID - 6000000
 AND [DateAllocatedUTC] <  @maxDate

DECLARE @ProcessID Int = ?;
DECLARE @UpdateDate datetime2(7) = GetDate();


UPDATE D
SET D.[FMSInvoiceID] = A.[FMSInvoiceID],
		D.[Price] = A.[Price],
		ProcessId = @ProcessID,
		Updated = @UpdateDate

FROM [FastwayDW].[dbo].[Dim_Label] D
INNER JOIN [FastwayDW].[dv].[SAT_Label_Allocation_DL] A ON A.LabelNo = D.LabelNo AND IsCurrent = 1
WHERE A.[ProcessId] = @ProcessID
